Lawvere.twist: {A B : Type} → (A → A → B) → (B → B) → A → B
Lawvere.lawvere:
{A B : Type} (φ : A → A → B) →
((g : A → B) → Σ-syntax A (λ a → φ a ≡ g)) →
(f : B → B) → Σ-syntax B (λ b → f b ≡ b)
Lawvere.noFix→noPtSurj:
{A B : Type} (φ : A → A → B) (g : B → B) →
((a : B) → ¬ g a ≡ a) → ¬ PtSurj φ
Lawvere.escapes:
{A B : Type} (φ : A → A → B) (g : B → B) →
((a : B) → ¬ g a ≡ a) → (f : A) → ¬ φ f ≡ twist φ g
Lawvere.defect:
{A B : Type} (φ : A → A → B) (g : B → B) →
((a : B) → ¬ g a ≡ a) →
Σ-syntax (A → B) (λ f → (b : A) → ¬ φ b ≡ f)
Lawvere.ptSurj→wk: {A B : Type} (φ : A → A → B) → PtSurj φ → WK.WkPtSurj φ
Lawvere.wk→ptSurj: {A B : Type} (φ : A → A → B) → WK.WkPtSurj φ → PtSurj φ
Lawvere.lawvere-agrees:
{A B : Type} (φ : A → A → B) (g : PtSurj φ) (a : B → B) →
lawvere φ g a .fst ≡ WK.lawvere φ (ptSurj→wk φ g) a .fst
Lawvere.cantor:
{A : Type} (B : A → A → Bool) →
¬ ((φ : A → Bool) → Σ-syntax A (λ g → B g ≡ φ))
Lawvere.cantor-defect:
{A : Type} (B : A → A → Bool) →
Σ-syntax (A → Bool) (λ φ → (g : A) → ¬ B g ≡ φ)
Lawvere.δ-end: {𝒬 = A : Type} (B : Quote A) (φ : A) → ¬ B φ ≡ EO.diag B
Lawvere.no-complete-quotation: {𝒬 = A : Type} (B : Quote A) → ¬ Complete B
Lawvere.δ-end-same-statement:
({𝒬 = A : Type} (B : Quote A) (φ : A) → ¬ B φ ≡ EO.diag B) ×
({𝒬 = g : Type} (a : Quote g) (f : g) → ¬ a f ≡ EO.diag a)
Lawvere.quotation-same-statement:
({𝒬 = A : Type} (B : Quote A) → ¬ Complete B) ×
({𝒬 = φ : Type} (g : Quote φ) → ¬ Complete g)
Lawvere.derivations-agree:
{𝒬 = A : Type} (B : Quote A) (φ : Complete B) →
no-complete-quotation B φ ≡ EO.no-complete-quotation B φ
Lawvere.quote-never-point-surjective: {𝒬 = A : Type} (B : Quote A) → ¬ PtSurj B
Lawvere.cadence-reopens:
{𝒬 = A : Type} (B : Quote A) →
Σ-syntax (Observable A) (λ φ → (g : A) → ¬ B g ≡ φ)
Lawvere.next-door-same-statement:
({𝒬 = A : Type} (B : Quote A) →
 Σ-syntax (Observable A) (λ φ → (g : A) → ¬ B g ≡ φ))
×
({𝒬 = a : Type} (f : Quote a) →
 Σ-syntax (Observable a) (λ b → (x : a) → ¬ f x ≡ b))
Lawvere.door-agrees:
{𝒬 = A : Type} (B : Quote A) →
cadence-reopens B .fst ≡ EO.next-door B .fst
Lawvere.cadence-never-closes:
{𝒬 = A : Type} (B : Quote A) (φ : Observable A) →
((g : A) → ¬ B g ≡ φ) →
Σ-syntax (Observable A)
(λ a → ((f : A) → ¬ B f ≡ a) × (¬ Σ-syntax A (λ b → B b ≡ φ)))
Lawvere.ptSurj-of-section:
{A B : Type} (φ : A → A → B) (g : (A → B) → A) →
((a : A → B) → φ (g a) ≡ a) → PtSurj φ
Lawvere.ptSurj-of-isEquiv: {A B : Type} (φ : A → A → B) → isEquiv φ → PtSurj φ
Lawvere.no-quote-section:
{A : Type} (B : A → A → Bool) (φ : (A → Bool) → A) →
¬ ((g : A → Bool) → B (φ g) ≡ g)
Lawvere.no-quote-equiv: {A : Type} (B : A → A → Bool) → ¬ isEquiv B
Lawvere.quote-never-equiv: {𝒬 = A : Type} (B : Quote A) → ¬ isEquiv B
